brd_json.Problem & Opportunity: Engineering leaders lose 22% of developer velocity to manual PR reviews and retroactive security audits. Traditional static analysis tools (SonarQube, Snyk) flag high false positives; an autonomous LLM auditor with verified codebase context cuts audit time by 60%.

brd_json.Go-to-Market Strategy: Product-led growth (PLG) developer tier on GitHub Marketplace feeding bottom-up enterprise sales. Seed target: 50 open-source repositories and 25 paying mid-market engineering teams.
brd_json.Regulatory & Compliance Risk: Customer IP and source code leakage is the primary sales blocker. Zero-data-retention agreements and VPC on-premise deployment options for Tier 1 banks are mandatory prerequisites.
brd_json.Financial Plan & Unit Economics: Priced at $45/contributor/month. Target 85% gross margins with LLM inference cost of $0.08 per PR. Breakeven at 180 paying seats.
